merger_description:
Vertis Bidco Pty Ltd (**Bidco**) is an investment vehicle which will be 100% owned and operated by Vertis Energy, a company 100% owned and operated by the Australia New Zealand Diversified Infrastructure Fund (Active) (**ADIF**). ADIF is a fund managed by Igneo Infrastructure Partners (**Igneo**) and is owned by its underlying investors, largely comprised of Australian superannuation funds and institutional investors. Bidco will acquire 100% of Green Squares Energy by way of a Sale and Purchase Agreement.

Igneo is a global infrastructure investment manager and the direct infrastructure arm of the First Sentier Group, a global asset management organisation headquartered in Sydney. It specialises in long term investments in mature, mid-market infrastructure businesses across sectors such as renewables, digital infrastructure, waste management, water utilities, transportation and logistics, with activity spanning Australia, New Zealand, Europe, the UK and North America. Igneo via First Sentier Group is ultimately controlled by Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group Inc.

Igneo 100% owns and operates Atmos Renewables Pty Ltd (**Atmos**), an Australian renewable energy independent power producer focused on owning, developing and operating large scale wind, solar and energy storage assets across Australia. Atmos holds a substantial portfolio of utility scale renewable generation projects distributed across multiple National Electricity Market states, supplying clean electricity to the grid and large energy users.

Igneo is also a majority investor in Clean Peak Energy Renewable Investment Trust (**CPERI**), a joint venture with CleanPeak Energy, which develops, owns and operates distributed renewable energy and multi-utility infrastructure assets at residential, commercial and industrial sites, including solar, battery storage and embedded network solutions supplying on-site electricity and related energy services to customers.

Green Squares Energy Pty Ltd and Green Squares Energy Trust together trade as Green Square Energy (together, **Green Squares Energy**). Green Squares Energy is an Australian energy business focused on renewable energy and electricity contracting solutions. It is primarily involved in structuring and financing commercial behind the meter renewable energy projects, including power purchase agreements, and supporting investment in solar and related clean energy projects. It also owns 2 front of the meter renewable energy assets which are connected to the NEM.

determination_table_content.details:
Vertis Bidco Pty Ltd and First Sentier Investors (Australia) Re Ltd
applied for a notification waiver in respect of Vertis Bidco Pty Ltd’s
proposed acquisition of Green Squares Energy Pty Ltd and the Green
Squares Energy Trust (together, Green Squares Energy), as
described in the transaction documents provided as part of the
application (the Acquisition).

The Australian Competition and Consumer Commission has
determined under section 51ABV(1)(a) of the Competition and
Consumer Act 2010 (Cth) that the Acquisition is not required to be
notified.

The acquirer, Vertis Bidco Pty Ltd (Bidco), is an investment vehicle
which will be 100% owned and operated by Vertis Energy, a company
100% owned and operated by the Australia New Zealand Diversified
Infrastructure Fund (Active) (ADIF). ADIF is a fund managed by Igneo
Infrastructure Partners (Igneo) and is owned by its underlying
investors, largely comprised of Australian superannuation funds and
institutional investors.
Igneo is a global infrastructure investment manager and the direct
infrastructure arm of the First Sentier Group, a global asset
management organisation headquartered in Sydney. It specialises in
long term investments in mature, mid-market infrastructure
businesses across sectors such as renewables, digital infrastructure,
waste management, water utilities, transportation and logistics, with
activity spanning Australia, New Zealand, Europe, the UK and North
America.
Igneo 100% owns and operates Atmos Renewables Pty Ltd (Atmos),
an Australian renewable energy independent power producer
focused on owning, developing and operating large scale wind, solar
and energy storage assets across Australia. Atmos holds a
substantial portfolio of utility scale renewable generation projects
distributed across multiple states, supplying clean electricity to the
grid and large energy users.
Igneo is also a majority investor in Clean Peak Energy Renewable
Investment Trust (CPERI), a joint venture with CleanPeak Energy,
which develops, owns and operates distributed renewable energy
and multi-utility infrastructure assets at residential, commercial and
industrial sites, including solar, battery storage and embedded
network solutions supplying on-site electricity and related energy
services to customers.
The target, Green Squares Energy, is an Australian energy business
focused on renewable energy and electricity contracting solutions. It
is primarily involved in structuring and financing commercial behind
the meter renewable energy projects, including power purchase
agreements, and supporting investment in solar and related clean
energy projects. It also owns 2 front of the meter renewable energy
assets which are connected to the NEM.

In making this notification waiver determination, the Australian
Competition and Consumer Commission (the ACCC) has considered
the information provided with the notification waiver application and
had regard to the factors in section 51ABV(2)(b) of the Competition
and Consumer Act 2010 (Cth) (the Act).
Based on the information currently before it, the ACCC considers that
the Acquisition is unlikely to give rise to any material lessening of
competition given:
a. the parties’ combined share in wholesale electricity
generation and supply in the National Electricity Market,
including in renewable energy generation, is estimated to be
low and the increase in share of supply arising from the
Acquisition is expected to be small
b. the parties’ combined share in the supply of behind the
meter solutions nationally is estimated to be low and the
increase in share of supply arising from the Acquisition is
expected to be small
c. there are alternative suppliers of wholesale electricity
generation to the National Electricity Market, including in
renewable energy generation, and of behind the meter
solutions nationally.
In these circumstances, the ACCC does not consider it necessary to
reach a concluded view on the likelihood of the notification
thresholds being met.
Given that material competition concerns are unlikely to arise, the
ACCC has determined that the Acquisition is not required to be
notified.
The ACCC considers that the determination is consistent with the
object of the Act and the interests of consumers in promoting
competition.
For more information about the ACCC’s approach to considering
notification waiver applications and to assessing competition
effects more generally, see the ACCC’s guidance on notification
waivers and merger assessment guidelines.
